artifact_status: primary-source cross-check complete; not an investability approval
purpose: Reconciles terms, fee rates and dated financial/holding facts for 511010, 510880 and 512890 against archived official primary disclosures. It does not substitute for current market, valuation, liquidity, tax, suitability or portfolio-risk diligence.

data_quality.fallback_path: none; discrepancies and gaps are retained rather than filled from secondary sources
warnings: Cross-check means agreement between dated official documents, not independent audit of fund-manager statements or an independent market-price validation.
2026 Q2 quantities, NAV, performance and holdings are unaudited and must retain that label in all downstream use.
PDS operating-cost rates are stated estimates based partly on the latest annual report; use them as disclosed estimates, not guaranteed future all-in holding costs.
Historical fund distributions are realised historical payments only. They are not forecasts, target cash flow or evidence that a 3% cash objective will be met.

verification_method.term_checks: Fund code, manager, custodian, mandate and benchmark were compared between the 2025 annual report and the later PDS and/or 2026 Q2 report.
verification_method.fee_checks: Management and custody fee rates in PDS were cross-checked to annual-report fee-accrual notes.
verification_method.financial_checks: 2025 year-end figures are retained only from audited annual reports; 2026-06-30 figures are retained only from the reports that explicitly mark their financial information unaudited.
verification_method.holding_checks: Holding and sector facts are assigned their exact report date and are not carried forward as current holdings.
verification_method.calculation_checks: Top-holding concentration is a transparent sum of the reported NAV weight percentages, subject to displayed-table rounding.
